common.tagline: Listen to, share and memorize the recitation of the Quran

mode.label: Mode
mode.firstBody: Reciter mode lets you upload your own recitations. Your name, country and approved recitations will appear on a public reciter page. You can switch back to listening at any time.

home.practiceBody: Recite from memory. Each word appears only after you say it, like covering the page of a mushaf.
home.emptyPopular: No plays this week yet. New recitations are below.
home.emptyNew: No recitations yet. Be the first to share one.
home.landingTitle: Recite, listen and memorize the Quran
home.landingBody: Stream recitations shared by the community, publish your own, and memorize with words that appear only as you recite them.
home.demoCaption: Words appear as you recite them
home.statPrivate: Your voice stays on your device
home.featureListenBody: All 114 surahs from community reciters, with a player that keeps going while you browse.
home.featureShareBody: Upload a file or record in the browser. Every recitation is reviewed before it is published.
home.featureMemorizeBody: The text stays hidden and each word appears as you say it. Mistakes are marked for review.
home.step2Body: Speech recognition runs on your device and reveals each word.
home.step3Body: See the words you skipped and practise exactly those again.
home.finalBody: An account saves your memorization progress, likes and playlists on every device.
home.greetingBody: Pick up where you left off.
home.progressEmpty: No practice yet. Choose a surah and recite it from memory.

surahs.title: Surahs
surahs.metaDescription: All 114 surahs of the Quran with community recitations.

surah.noRecitationsTitle: No recitations of this surah yet
surah.noRecitationsBody: Recite it and share it with others.

recitation.pendingNotice: Waiting for review. Only you and moderators can see it.
recitation.reportSent: Thank you. A moderator will review it.
recitation.alreadyReported: You have already reported this recitation.

player.label: Audio player
player.error: This recitation could not be played.

upload.title: Upload a recitation
upload.titleHint: For example: Surat al-Mulk, evening recitation
upload.fileHint: MP3, M4A, OGG or WebM, up to 60 MB. 64–96 kbps mono keeps files small.
upload.rights: This is my own recitation or I have permission to share it.
upload.pendingBody: A moderator will listen before it becomes public. You can follow it in your reciter studio.
upload.needReciterTitle: Switch to reciter mode to upload
upload.needReciterBody: Uploads belong to your reciter profile. Turning it on takes one click and you can switch back any time.
upload.errorType: This file type is not supported.
upload.errorSize: The file is larger than 60 MB.
upload.errorQuota: Your storage is full. Remove an old recitation to upload a new one.
upload.errorGeneric: The upload failed. Please try again.
upload.errorRange: That ayah range does not exist in this surah.
upload.sourceLabel: How do you want to add the audio?
upload.recordHint: Recite in a quiet room, about a hand’s width from the microphone. Recording stops by itself after 60 minutes.
upload.recordPrivacy: Your recording stays on this device until you press Upload.
upload.recordDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in your browser’s site settings, or choose a file instead.
upload.recordUnsupported: This browser cannot record audio. Choose a file instead.
upload.recordFailed: Recording stopped unexpectedly. Please try again.

library.title: Library
library.publicHint: Anyone with the link can listen.
library.emptyLiked: Recitations you like will appear here.
library.emptyPlaylists: Make a playlist for Fajr, for travel, or for revision.
library.signInTitle: Sign in to see your library

studio.title: Reciter studio
studio.empty: You have not uploaded a recitation yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.countryHint: Two letters, for example PK, EG, GB.
settings.deleteBody: This deletes your account, likes, playlists and memorization progress. Your recitations are removed. This cannot be undone.
settings.reauth: For your safety, sign in again before deleting your account.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.emptyUploads: Nothing waiting. The queue is clear.
moderation.openReports: {count, plural, one {# open report} other {# open reports}}
moderation.forbidden: Only moderators can see this page.

auth.name: Name
auth.resetBody: Enter your email and we will send you a link.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed. Sign in with it now.
auth.invalid: The email or password is not correct.
auth.exists: An account with this email already exists.
auth.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.verifySent: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to activate your account and sign in.
auth.notVerified: Verify your email address before signing in. Check your inbox, or send the link again.
auth.resent: A new link is on its way to {email}.

memorize.title: Memorize
memorize.intro: Choose what to practise. Recite from memory and each word appears as you say it.
memorize.privacy: Your voice is processed on your device. It is never uploaded or stored.
memorize.modeRevealHint: Each word appears as soon as you say it.
memorize.modeCheckHint: The ayah stays hidden until you finish it, then shows what you got right.
memorize.modeListenHint: Hear a reciter say the ayah, then repeat it from memory.
memorize.downloadNote: This happens once. The model is then kept in your browser and works offline.
memorize.wrongAyah: That sounds like ayah {heard}. Continue from ayah {expected}.
memorize.savedLocal: Saved in this browser. Sign in to keep your progress on every device.
memorize.listenNone: No recording of ayah {n} yet. Recite it from memory.
memorize.micDenied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in your browser’s site settings.
memorize.engineFailed: The speech model could not start on this device. Try another browser, or reload the page.
memorize.saveFailed: Could not save to your account, so it was saved in this browser.
memorize.textHint: Faint: words darken as you recite them. Hidden: test yourself without seeing the text.
memorize.quietMic: We can't hear you. Check that the right microphone is selected in your browser and that it isn't muted.

errors.notFoundTitle: This page could not be found
errors.notFoundBody: It may have been moved, or the link may be mistyped.
errors.genericBody: Please try again. If it keeps happening, come back later.

footer.audio: Recitations are shared by their reciters.

admin.usersIntro: Every account, newest first. Search by name or email, filter by role, and manage verification and roles.
admin.verifiedHint: Their uploads are published without review and their name shows a verified badge. This also turns on their reciter profile.
admin.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
admin.selfRole: You cannot change your own role.

hadith.intro: Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim in Arabic, with English and Urdu translations.
hadith.searchPlaceholder: Words in Arabic, English or Urdu, or a hadith number
hadith.noResults: No hadith found. Try fewer or different words.
hadith.noEnglish: No English translation for this hadith in the source.
hadith.noUrdu: No Urdu translation for this hadith in the source.
hadith.noArabic: No Arabic text for this hadith in the source.
hadith.creditsUrdu: Urdu translation: the translator is not named in the source.
